name: Optics: Prismoor
subtitle: Optics course, labs, practice
shortDescription: Adaptive optics course: lenses, interference, diffraction and polarization with six hands-on labs. Free to use.
longDescription:
Optics course for university students: learn geometrical, wave and modern optics with an adaptive tutor, 301 original problems with worked solutions, and six interactive labs.

Optics: Prismoor follows a standard undergraduate optics syllabus in 24 topics: Fermat's principle and Snell's law, total internal reflection and prisms, mirrors and thin lenses, ray-transfer (ABCD) matrices, optical instruments, aberrations, electromagnetic waves and Fresnel reflection, polarization and Jones vectors, interference (Young, thin film, Michelson, Fabry-Perot), coherence, Fraunhofer and Fresnel diffraction, gratings, Fourier optics and spatial filtering, lasers and Gaussian beams, optical fibres, nonlinear optics and photons.

### How It Teaches
- Adaptive path: the tutor tracks your mastery of each topic, tags the slip behind every wrong answer (a swapped index, a forgotten round trip, a sign convention) and serves problems that test it again. Or follow the syllabus order; switch any time.
- 301 original problems: multiple choice and typed numeric answers, each with a free worked solution.
- Mock exams: 20 questions, 30 minutes, verified items only.
- Spaced review: topics return after 1, 3, 7, 16 and 35 days.
- Pop-ups explain any concept at school level, course level and graduate level.
- Sources are cited and linked: textbooks, MIT OpenCourseWare and OpenStax syllabi (all lessons and problems are our own).

### Six Optics Labs
Ray bench with a two-lens ABCD readout; slits and gratings pattern; thin-film colour; Michelson rings with coherence; polarizer stack and wave plate; 4f Fourier filter.

### Free, With Optional Ad Removal
The app is free with ads shown only at natural breaks (never during exams or before explanations). An optional rewarded video earns a credit for an extra mock exam. A monthly ad-free subscription (price shown in the App Store, 7-day free trial) removes all ads. It renews automatically until cancelled in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions. Worked solutions and lessons are never locked.

Not affiliated with any university, publisher or exam body. Works offline; no account needed.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
